scratch.title: From scratch
scratch.description: A blank canvas, we'll guide you step by step

advanced.title: We're already well along
advanced.description: Tell us what you already have and we'll organize it

civil.label: Civil
civil.hint: Legally binding, at a town hall or elsewhere

religiosa.label: Religious
religiosa.hint: In a church or another place of worship

simbolica.label: Symbolic
simbolica.hint: A ceremony your own way, with no legal paperwork

date.label: Wedding date
date.help: Once you set the date, tubodadiy starts the countdown for you.

budget.label: Total budget in euros
budget.help: A rough figure is fine; you can change it whenever you like.

approx.label: Approximate number of guests
approx.help: A rough number is fine. You'll fine-tune it when you build the list.

venue.scopeQuestion: Is it for the ceremony, the reception or both?

guests.label: Paste your list here
guests.placeholder:
Anna Smith; Bride's family
Luke Parker; Friends
Maria Lopez
guests.help: One guest per line. If you paste from Excel or Google Sheets, the first column is the name and the second is the group (optional). Separating with ";" or a comma works too.
guests.skippedHeader: We skipped the first row because it looks like a header.

honeymoon.label: Honeymoon destination
honeymoon.help: It's optional: we'll note it in the Honeymoon section.

summary.blank: You're starting with a blank canvas: we'll guide you step by step through the 13 sections of the plan.

creating.title: Getting your plan ready
creating.dontClose: Please don't close this page until we're done.

stages.plan: Creating your plan and its sections
stages.steps: Ticking off what you've already done

create.error: The plan couldn't be created. Please try again.
create.partial: We created the plan, but couldn't add {{items}}. You can add it from the plan.

leave.title: Leave without creating the plan?
leave.description: You'll lose what you've written so far.

errors.budgetInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 12,000.
errors.guestsInvalid: Enter a whole number, for example 120.
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1,500.

name.title: What's your plan called?
name.description: A name to recognize it by. You can change it whenever you like.

mode.title: How would you like to start?
mode.description: Choose whatever suits you best. You can always add more later.

have.title: What do you already have?
have.description: Tick everything that's already decided or booked. We'll only ask for those details.

date.title: Do you have a date yet?
date.description: Pick the day on the calendar.

budget.title: What's your total budget?
budget.description: What you plan to spend on the whole wedding.

ceremony.title: What kind of ceremony would you like?
ceremony.titleAdvanced: What kind of ceremony are you having?
ceremony.description: We'll note it in the Ceremony section.

approx.title: How many guests are you expecting?

venue.title: Which venue have you booked?
venue.description: We'll save it in Vendors as your chosen venue.

guests.title: Share your guest list with us
guests.description: Copy it from wherever you keep it and paste it here; we'll sort it out.

vendors.title: Which vendors have you hired?
vendors.description: Tick the ones you already have. We'll save them as chosen; the name and price are optional.

honeymoon.title: Where are you going on your honeymoon?
honeymoon.description: If you already know, tell us.

summary.title: All set to begin
summary.description: This is what we'll prepare for you. You can change everything afterwards from the plan.

venue.ambos: Booked for the ceremony and the reception.

notes.vendorMissing: Still need to add the name and contact details.
notes.rings: We already have the wedding rings.
